object: FIELD INDEX / semantic scale + FOVEA use pass
before: FIELD/ROUTE/OBJECT semantic scale was merged and CI-green, but its use was under-explained on phone and FOVEA still listened to mouse movement. FOVEA click capture could also let the same physical click reach the underlying route control after changing focus.
delta: Teach FIELD / ROUTE / OBJECT meaning in the scale rail itself and expose phone-specific tap guidance without adding a tutorial panel.
Move FOVEA tracking from mouse-only movement to Pointer Events so mouse, pen and touch share one aperture path.
Make FOVEA own addressed-mark clicks while active: first activation holds, activating the held mark again opens; shift-click remains immediate OPEN on desktop.
Keep page scrolling available when FOVEA is not over an addressed mark; wheel peer traversal consumes scroll only over a valid target.
laws: One physical action must not be interpreted twice by stacked interaction layers.
A projection should teach its minimum viable operation at the point of use.
Touch, pen and mouse may share an interaction law without pretending their gestures are identical.
Projection changes never mutate FIELD route identity, CURRENT attention or native host authority.

verification.source: PENDING CI on PR branch; require public-surface-check including critical browser smoke plus route registration.
verification.human: PENDING: ordinary-use check on a real phone: switch bands, focus/open a mark, enable FOVEA, drag across marks, and confirm scrolling remains controllable.
verification.limit: Pointer/browser tests cannot prove the touch interaction feels clear in ordinary phone use.

next: Use FIELD root on phone once. If a gesture is ambiguous, change the smallest interaction law or label; do not add another navigation layer.
stop: Do not add pinch-to-zoom, a tutorial modal, or a second focus store unless ordinary-use evidence shows the three-band + FOVEA model cannot be learned in place.
upstream_preserved: PR #485 semantic-scale law remains intact: FIELD/ROUTE/OBJECT changes projection density; MAP depth changes topology; FOVEA is local detail; all preserve one addressed focus.
